title: Genomic annotation and publication-grade visualization
text: GAnnoViz: R package genomic annotation visualization. GAnnoViz cloud-integrated framework chromosome-level feature annotation visualization multi-omics research. provides analytical visualization capabilities R packages, integrating cloud platform enable real-time interactive data analysis. current release consists 30+ functions three datasets, collectively addressing four core analytical requirements: genomic features extraction, gene structure drawing, sliding-window annotation, multi-omics chromosome-level visualization. source code example datasets available GitHub repository open-source license, facilitating reproducibility community-driven development issue reporting pull requests. title: Genomic annotation and publication-grade visualization
text: built-example genomic annotations multi-omics datasets GAnnoViz package accompanying cloud platform provided demonstration purposes, enabling users rapidly prepare input data reference. structure example datasets can inspected dedicated functions, files publicly accessible download source code repository cloud platform. default reference genomic annotation employed latest version mouse (Mus musculus) genome, GRCm39.115, sourced Ensembl database v115 formatted standard GFF3. annotation includes complete chromosomes, gene coordinate information, well-defined hierarchical feature relationships. current historical genomic annotation versions humans key species can obtained directly Ensembl, GAnnoViz supports parsing newly assembled genomic annotation. Ensembl Genomic Annotation: https://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-115/gff3/ Ensembl release 115: Species GFF3 349

title: Genomic annotation and publication-grade visualization
text: multi-omics example datasets simulated illustrative purposes adhere widely adopted formats field. Standard gene differential expression matrices generated using DESeq2 v1.50.2, differentially expressed genes (DEGs) identified |log2(FoldChange)| > 1 padj < 0.05. Differential methylation results generated using MethylKit v1.36.0, differentially methylated regions (DMRs) identified |meth.diff| > 25 qvalue < 0.05. Data files can directly loaded standard R data objects via built-reading functions cloud platform’s data upload interface, eliminating need users pre-process genome annotations multi-omics results tabular formats prior analysis.
